source_title: Kareena Kapoor Khan, Shahid Kapoor break the internet again as they hug at an event, netizens can't get o - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Kareena Kapoor Khan and Shahid Kapoor remain one of the most iconic on-screen pairs in Hindi cinema, thanks to 'Jab We Met'. But seeing them together now is also special for fans due to the fact that they were in a relationship at one point of time. The duo reunited at an event on Thursday afternoon. While Kareena opted for a black leather top and skirt look, Shahid was in a white suit. They greeted each other cordially with a hug as they met at an event. As this hug went viral on the internet, fans can't keep calm. Last year as well, their conversation from an event on stage went viral and netizens got nostalgic about about 'Jab We Met'. With their hug now going viral, fans are emotional and want to see them in a movie together.A user said, "Why am I getting emotional ð¢seeing this ð" Another one said, "Why are we so happy?" A fan commented, "Hum emotional ho jate hai." Many also commented that they want to see them in a movie together. Someone wrote, "Geet and Aditya"While Kareena is happily married to Saif Ali Khan and has two children, Shahid and his wife Mira Rajput serve couple goals. Recently fans were surprised as Mira appeared on Kareena's show 'What Women Want' and their picture together went viral. Fans were happy to see Mira and Kareena getting along with each other and their little exchange on social media.After the shoot, Mira took to social media to share a couple of pictures from the sets, accompanied by a heartfelt note for Kareena. She wrote, "What women want is to be themselves. Thanks @kareenakapoorkhan for having me and for being the woman you are." Kareena responded to the post with a warm comment, writing, "So happy you came, gorgeous."Kareena also shared a picture with Mira on her Instagram Story, praising her guest. "The absolutely warm and lovely Mira on the show today," she wrote. Mira reshared the Story and expressed her appreciation for Kareena, captioning it, "Could not have better company. With the gorgeous Kareena Kapoor Khan."Shahid Kapoor and Mira Rajput tied the knot on July 7, 2015.
